Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Chandan Agarwal Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
Heard Sri Om Narayan Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Sri Chandan Agarwal, learned Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of the respondent-NHAI.
Sri Apurva Hajela, learned Standing Counsel has put in appearance on behalf of the State-respondents.

The prayer in the writ petition is to pay compensation for acquisition of the land of the petitioners,
which has been acquired by acquisition notification issued under Section 3A(1) and 3D of the National Highways Act, 1956 for the purpose of widening of National Highways from 15 km to 47 km.

Further prayer in the writ petition is to issue direction in the nature of mandamus commanding Naveen Kumar And 12 Others vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 12 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39958640/

sentences.text: the Respondent no.4, namely, the competent authority to decide objections of the petitioner under Section 3C(1) of the Act, 1956.

Various contentions have been made in the writ petition to assert that without proper preparation of record and survey of the land in question, acquisition proceedings had been undertaken by the respondents, which has resulted in making various discrepancies in the matter of acquisition.

We are afraid to accept the contention of the petitioner on the issue of survey and preparation of record prior to the acquisition in question, as there is no challenge to the acquisition notifications in the instant case.
As regards the objections of the petitioners under Section 3C(1), with the issuance of the notification under Section 3D, their objections stand disposed off.
No mandamus as such can be issued.

With regard to payment of compensation to petitioner has to wait for the award or to move a proper application before the competent authority for disbursement of the compensation under the award, if it is already made.
In any case, no positive mandamus can be issued.
The writ petition is accordingly, dismissed.
